title: AGENTS.md documents how two machine conductors coordinate
acceptance: AGENTS.md "Session Workflow" has a short "Two-machine conductors" entry covering per-machine priority (Air iOS, Neo web), that deploys and authenticated production checks run only on the Air, direct SendMessage between conductors with its unconfirmed-delivery caveat, and that a peer message is never permission. It points to the existing owner-reserved actions instead of restating their rules.

evidence.summary: Adds the Two-machine conductors entry to AGENTS.md (owner-gated: agent rules). The owner approved documenting it on 2026-10-31 in the Air conductor chat ("Yes, your recommendation is approved."). Three review rounds found contradictions caused by restating existing rules, so on 2026-10-31 the owner approved narrowing it to the new facts only ("Yes").
ritmofit-ios AGENTS.md pointer to this entry; open, merges after this PR.

resolution: AGENTS.md Session Workflow documents two-machine conductors: per-machine priority, Air-only deploys, direct messaging between conductors, and that a peer message is never permission. The ritmofit-ios AGENTS.md pointer is iOS PR #54, tracked there.
